edits.name: plants-roots-spaced
edits.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the provided nine-plant sprite atlas. Keep all NINE exact subjects, their materials, styling, lighting, colors, and row-major ordering. Fix ONLY layout and scale so each object fits inside its own non-overlapping rectangular cell, suitable for extracting independent AtlasTexture sprites. Use a strict 3 by 3 equal grid on a square image, no visible grid. Center each asset in its cell with at least 40 pixels of transparent clearance to every cell boundary. In particular SHORTEN the middle hanging ivy to stay fully inside the middle cell; its tail MUST NOT extend into the bottom thorn bush. SHRINK the wide branch in the middle-left cell and the dead branch in bottom-left cell to fit their cells. Shrink other objects as needed for the same padding. No object, twig, leaf or shadow may cross its cell boundaries. Background and ALL space between objects must be genuinely transparent, and the open spaces inside plants must remain transparent. Do not add a backdrop, floor, glow or shadows outside the cutouts. No new objects, no text, labels, grid lines or borders. Preserve detailed polished stylized 3D game appearance of reference.
